title: Harden service redeployment defaults against remote HTTP exposure
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that Scripts/Redeploy-MemorySmithService.ps1 defaults to all-interface binding, enables AllowRemoteApi, and continues with HTTP if no certificate exists, overriding safer appsettings defaults. Evidence: Scripts/Redeploy-MemorySmithService.ps1 lines 21, 29, 503, 525. Fail closed to loopback; require explicit remote exposure plus HTTPS and a valid certificate.
